subject: Bounded repeat of mission 1995 corpse-to-wreck unreset-timer route in the isolated original client
setup: The same isolated recovered 1.16.5.0 client, Wine prefix and copied Auth/Game/SQLite world were used after the previous harness stopped. Before client launch, the copied objective-3-active soldier checkpoint was placed at (-94.73047,84.99609,65.640625), the previously ordinary-reached corpse-use floor coordinate. This is an explicit diagnostic login position edit. After login, no timer or position reset, teleport, GM movement, world/content edit, live Docker or DIT edit occurred. The 78 harness commands are sealed in command-ledger.json.

observations.finding: Right-click at the corpse completed objective 3 in this single client session. The tracker switched to destroying the dropship with 00:09:58 remaining.

observations.uncertainty: The original-client .where output rounds coordinates; held-key timing and collision vary with client frame rate. Screenshots sample endpoints, not a continuous path trace.
observations.finding: Ordinary movement reached (-100.734,84.770,57.645), (-109.168,83.770,39.281), (-124.855,83.520,38.473), (-137.496,84.270,37.824), and (-152.008,84.203,37.262) while objective 1's unreset countdown remained active. This was a more northerly line along bridge rubble than the prior dry-bank route via approximately (-134,84.77,29). It did not reach the wreck.

At the bridge rubble the .where helper again left chat in UI Mode, and an A hold appeared as typed chat text. After closing it and clicking the world, further ordinary movement remained locally obstructed near the metal geometry. No bomb-use prompt or second RequestUseObject occurred. The countdown expired; copied SQLite persisted mission 1995 state 2, objective 1 status 3, and objectives 2 and 3 status 2, with integrity_check ok. The harness focus fault and missed dry-bank turn prevent treating this as evidence that ten minutes are insufficient in normal gameplay.

assessment: A second single-session timed route did not reach or use the bomb. It confirms the corpse interaction and persistent wall-clock failure path, and narrows the route-control issue to the bridge area around x[-138,-152], z[37,38] plus unreliable chat focus. It does not justify changing content or the 600-second analogue timer, and it does not establish final-live route fidelity.
next_verification: Avoid the northerly bridge-rubble line: from the ordinary-reached (-124.855,83.520,38.473) steer toward the previously observed dry-bank (-134.2,84.77,29.35), then continue via (-159.3,84.82,7.27). Use a controller that asserts gameplay focus without relying on .where chat after each key hold; approach the final wreck through short visual segments and click only when its use prompt renders. A completed uninterrupted ten-minute corpse-to-bomb run is still missing.
